items.question: Is a practitioner endowed with medhā-dīkṣā attained or not, dear one?
premises: medhā-dīkṣā endowment is the stated condition
the address is to a dear one
items.inference: The verse asks whether endowment with medhā-dīkṣā entails attainment.
uncertainties: exact technical scope of medhā-dīkṣā remains context-dependent
whether prāpyate refers to ritual or spiritual attainment is not explicit
items.plain_english: O dear one, is one endowed with medhā-dīkṣā attained or not?
